description: Barcelona is Spain's second largest city, with a population of nearly two million people, and the capital of Catalonia. A major port on the northeastern Mediterranean coast of Spain, Barcelona has a wide variety of attractions that bring in tourists from around the globe.

name: Amsterdam
activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands. It is known for the canals that cross the city, its impressive architecture, museums and art galleries, its notorious red light district, and more than 1,500 bridges.

name: Prague
activities: adventure; culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Prague (Czech: Praha) is the capital and largest city of the Czech Republic. The city's historic buildings and narrow, winding streets are testament to its centuries-old role as capital of the historic region of Bohemia.

description: Athens (Greek: , Athína) is the capital city of Greece. It was the major cultural, political and religious centre of Classical Greece, a place that deeply influenced the course of Western civilization.

activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife
description: Reykjavík is the capital of and largest city in Iceland and with an urban area population of around 233,000 (2019), it is the home to two-thirds of Iceland's population. It is the centre of culture and life of the Icelandic people, and is one of the focal points of tourism in Iceland.

name: Oslo
activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Oslo is Norway's capital and largest city, with 700,000 citizens in the city proper and about 1.5 million inhabitants in greater Oslo. It is in the East of the country in the Oslofjorden fjord, extending over an inlet of the Skagerrak strait.

name: Dubrovnik
activities: beach; culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: thumb|300px|The Old Harbour at Dubrovnik Dubrovnik is a historic walled city on the Adriatic Sea coast in the extreme south of Croatia. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the Mediterranean, a seaport and the centre of the Dubrovnik-Neretva County.

name: Split
activities: beach; culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Split is a city in Central Dalmatia, Croatia, and the seat of the Split-Dalmatia county. The city was built around the Diocletian palace (a palace/fort built for the retired Roman emperor Diocletian) where the locals sought refuge centuries ago.

name: Venice
activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Venice (Italian: Venezia; Venetian: Venexia) is a sanctuary on a lagoon that is virtually the same as it was 600 years ago, which adds to the fascinating character. Venice has decayed since its heyday and suffers from overtourism, but the romantic charm remains.

name: Berlin
activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Berlin is Germany's capital and largest city. Within the city limits, Berlin in 2022 had a population of 3.7 million.

name: Vienna
activities: culture; food; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Vienna (German: Wien; Austro-Bavarian: Wean) is the capital of Austria and by far its most populous city, with an urban population of 2 million and a metropolitan population of 2.9 million (2023). It is the country's artistic, cultural, economic and political centre.

name: Copenhagen
activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Copenhagen (Danish: København) is the capital city of Denmark and forms the moderate conurbation that one million Danes call home. It is big enough to form a small Danish metropolis, with shopping, culture and nightlife par excellence, yet small enough still to feel intimate and be safe.

name: Edinburgh

description: Edinburgh (Gaelic: Dùn Èideann) is the capital of Scotland, located in the Central Belt of the country. With a population of 526,470 in the urban area in 2021, and 901,455 in the metropolitans, Edinburgh fizzes with a cosmopolitan yet uniquely Scottish atmosphere.

activities: culture; food; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Porto is Portugal's second largest city and the capital of the Northern region, and a busy industrial and commercial centre. name: Istanbul
activities: culture; food; history; nature; nightlife; shopping

activities: culture; food; nature; nightlife; shopping
description: Nairobi is the political, as well as financial and media capital of Kenya. A city of 4.8 million inhabitants (as of 2024), it's the largest and fastest growing city in the country and one of Africa's largest cities.
